recommend: Recommended for medium to high-end devices.
disclaimer_p1: The game utilizes a music speed-up mechanic. To ensure the smoothest audio experience, the Preserved Pitch option is DISABLED BY DEFAULT (faster BGM will have higher-pitched voice effect).
disclaimer_p2: Unless you dislike this effect, it is NOT RECOMMENDED to enable Preserved Pitch. When ENABLED, the audio processing will cause distortion and glitches at high speeds, which may cause discomfort and auditory fatigue.
disclaimer_note: This can be adjusted at any time in the Settings Menu.

extensions_desc: Additional expansion features for the game.
quality_desc: Affects block detail and image resolution.
sw_desc: Circular ripple effect when the ball hits a tile.
color_desc: Tiles automatically change colors over time.
vis_desc: Displays dynamic audio spectrum waves in the background.
particle_desc: Adds floating glowing dust particles in space (GPU intensive).
anim_desc: Tiles compress and bounce slightly when touched by the ball.
block_shatter_desc: Spawns 3D debris fragments when hitting broken or fake tiles.
ball_aura_desc: Ball will emit a glowing fire-like aura when reaching a 6+ PERFECT combo.
ball_glow_desc: The ball emits a neon glow effect when achieving a combo of 6+ PERFECTs.
ball_trail_desc: Renders a 3D luminous trail behind the ball (GPU intensive).
boundaries_desc: Display limit lines on both sides of the track.
advanced_boundaries_desc: Emits 3D luminous dust particles rising along both track boundaries colored by difficulty.
menu_vol_desc: Background music volume in main menu.
preview_vol_desc: Preview song volume in the song selection screen.
pregame_vol_desc: Waiting music volume on Tap To Play screen.
mfx_game_over_vol_desc: Background music volume on Game Over screen.
sfx_vol_desc: Sound effect volume for UI button clicks (excludes Play button).
play_sfx_vol_desc: Sound effect volume when pressing the Play button to start.
ui_vol_desc: Score counting and new record sound volume.
break_block_vol_desc: Volume of the fake block breaking sound effect.
sens_desc: Ball responsiveness when swiping or dragging.
ahead_desc: Number of blocks rendered ahead (increases view distance).
behind_desc: Number of blocks kept behind you.
rel_pc_desc: Click and drag to move (like on mobile).
raw_input_desc: Disables all smoothing effects. Ball reacts instantly 1:1 with mouse movement.
spawn_desc: Choose animation style for newly spawned blocks.
data_mng_desc: Update new content or completely reset progress.
limit_beatmap_audio_desc: Limit the maximum number of cached songs (LRU). When exceeded, the least recently used song will be automatically deleted.
msg_confirm_delete_song_cache: Are you sure you want to clear the cache (audio and beatmap) for the song "{name}"?
msg_beatmap_cleared: All beatmap cache cleared! Maps will be re-downloaded when played.
install_ios_guide: On iOS: Tap the 'Share' icon in Safari, then select 'Add to Home Screen' to install the game.
sw_auto_update_desc: Automatically notify when a new app version is available.
msg_new_update: A new version is available! Would you like to reload to apply it now?
msg_map_updated: The map has been updated to the latest version!
msg_map_error_desc: Failed to download map after 60 seconds. Please check your connection and try again.
play_mode_normal_desc: Play the basic song once. Complete it to unlock Endless Mode.
play_mode_endless_desc: Run infinitely with increasing speed. Challenge your highscore limits!
fake_blocks_desc: Fake blocks spawn randomly next to real ones. They break and fall when touched.
ext_cat_modes_desc: Customize game difficulty and gameplay mechanics
ext_cat_assists_desc: Jump assist tools and control customization
relax_mode_desc: Auto-plays smoothly. Enjoy the music and 3D visuals without playing.
easy_mode_desc: Blocks under 0.25s are aligned straight, 0.25s-0.8s max 1/2 offset. High scores & Endless mode locked.
hard_mode_desc: Fake blocks spawn continuously and moving blocks run at extremely high speeds.
asian_mode_desc: Ultra hard: Blazing fast moving blocks, min 1-block jump during no-fake steps. No highscores recorded.
bot_assist_desc: Auto-corrects ball to center if within 50% of block's half-width. (No highscore)
invert_controls_desc: Swipe left to move right, and vice versa.
tile_detail_desc: Adjusts block detail and sharpness (10% - 500%). High values may reduce performance.
preserve_pitch_game_desc: Do not change pitch when increasing song speed. May cause discomfort and audio desync at high speeds.
bg_music_desc: Allows audio to keep playing when the browser tab is inactive or unfocused.
offline_msg: You are offline! Only cached songs can be played.
offline_msg_skip: No internet! Music player stopped because this song is not cached.
offline_msg_ext: No internet! Cannot load this extension because it's not cached offline.
credit_suggest: * We recommend you to Credit the song before posting videos on Social Media. If this music is being distributed by an entity, please contact them to request or purchase a license if available.
msg_sync_success: Successfully synced the latest playlist from the server!
loading_tip_1: Maintain a PERFECT streak to change the ball and trail color to Yellow, Orange, and Purple.
loading_tip_2: In Settings, you can disable graphical effects to improve performance on weaker devices.
loading_tip_3: 'Relax Mode' plays the game automatically. Perfect for enjoying the music and 3D visuals.
loading_tip_4: Use headphones for the best audio experience and to feel the rhythm more clearly.
loading_tip_5: Don't just watch the ball; try to observe the upcoming tiles in the distance.
loading_tip_6: Each song has its own unique beatmap. Replaying helps you memorize it for a higher score.
loading_tip_7: Enable 'Bot Assist' if you're having trouble. It helps you aim but won't save your high score.
loading_tip_8: The game speed gradually increases in Endless Mode. Prepare for the challenge!
perf_mode_desc: Maximize FPS by temporarily disabling intensive graphical effects.
auto_fullscreen_desc: Automatically enter fullscreen on play and exit when returning to menu.
show_fps_desc: Display frames per second (FPS) in the corner during gameplay.
